tests.name: Heap Delta at 10K Records
tests.detail: YON streaming heap delta at 10K records: 20.12 MB. Streaming mode (accumulate: false) — records are consumed, not retained.

tests.name: Heap Delta at 100K Records

tests.name: Memory Growth Factor (100K / 10K)
tests.detail: 10K delta: 20.10 MB. 100K delta: 123.10 MB. Growth factor: 6.12x. A factor near 1.0 proves O(1) memory — heap is flat regardless of scale.
